changelog: **Report subscriptions — scheduled delivery of registry reports** (#1905, part 1; docs/report-subscriptions.md). New tenant models `ReportSubscription` + `ReportSubscriptionSend` (`@@unique([subscriptionId, periodKey])`). An admin with `ADVANCED_ANALYTICS` subscribes a user of the org or an external address to any registry report — weekly / monthly / quarterly at a UTC hour, in EN/TR/DE, as an e-mail table or a CSV/XLSX attachment (the latter needs `REPORT_EXPORT`) — via `/api/admin/report-subscriptions` (CRUD + send-me-a-test). Everything is validated when written (unknown report → 400). An hourly job (`src/lib/jobs/reportSubscriptions.ts`, registered from `/api/cron/start`, manual `GET /api/cron?job=report-subscriptions`) claims each period before sending, so a retry sends nothing; it re-checks the entitlement, the user's `analytics-report` opt-out and the org's e-mail block list, and renders stage labels in the recipient's language behind the privacy floor. External recipients leave through an HMAC-signed link (`/reports/unsubscribe`, POST `/api/report-subscriptions/unsubscribe`). The cohort/source/mentor computations moved out of their routes into `src/lib/analyticsReports.ts`, so the report registry no longer needs a session. Covered by `scripts/test/report-subscriptions.test.mjs` and `e2e/report-subscriptions.spec.ts`.
